title: Qman DirectPath aggregated CaseCompletionRecord
description: Signed deterministic aggregation of one or more EXECUTED_PASS scenarios against one closed Case contract. It is the only portable object that may claim a PRODUCT Case complete; an individual scenario, test log, VMware observation or blocked Case cannot.
x-qmanAggregationRule: Resolve the current generated Case contract independently. Every scenarioPath, executionEvidenceIndexPath and runnerManifestPath is a repository-contained path in evidence commit E; verify each raw file against scenarioSha256, evidenceIndexRecordSha256 or runnerManifestSha256 before parsing, then verify its internal signed digest against executionResultDigest, executionEvidenceIndexDigest or runnerManifestDigest. Every scenario/index/result/runner is schema-valid, signed, EXECUTED_PASS, limitation-free, same caseId/C/M/portable contract/target commit and at least this evidenceGrade. Every transitive scenario applicability resolves to exactly platformProfileId; its targetBinding.platformProfileDigest and backendProfileDigest byte-equal this record, so runs from different platform or backend profiles cannot be unioned. Independently recompute platformProfileDigest from the active compatibility-policy row. For E3 exactQualificationKey is null and backendProfileDigest is the singleton value shared by every signed scenario target binding. For E4 exactQualificationKey is non-null; all indexes resolve the same byte-identical QualificationSubjectManifest, whose policy-derived platformProfileHash, SHA-256(CANONICAL-JSON-V1(kernelQemuFirmwareBackend)) and independently recomputed nine-field exact qualification-key projection respectively equal platformProfileDigest, backendProfileDigest and exactQualificationKey. The three raw hashes and the three internal digests are pairwise bound through the referenced documents; labels or unresolvable digests are not evidence. observedCoverage equals the exact set union and numeric sums re-derived from those referenced documents, not a self-declared subset. It covers every required port, operation, transition, fault class, artifact schema, oracle class and assertion digest; every required fault class reaches minimumRepeat and total duration reaches minimumDurationSeconds.
x-qmanDependencyRule: dependencyCompletionDigests exactly covers Case dependsOnCaseIds. Every dependency record is independently valid, PRODUCT, EXECUTABLE, same target C/M/portable contract and byte-identical platformProfileId/platformProfileDigest/backendProfileDigest/exactQualificationKey, and completed before this record. In an IntegrationReport or QualificationReleaseIndex, each edge resolves to exactly one signed completion descriptor by completionDigest; a standalone record with a non-empty dependency array has status UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE until the complete descriptor set is separately supplied. Cycles, missing/unready dependencies, descriptor relabeling or cross-platform/backend/qualification substitution fail closed.
x-qmanEvaluatorRule: Resolve evaluator.path/blobSha256/interfaceHash from target commit C, including a bounded recursively verified submodule when applicable, and require exactly one signed mapping binding for the Case-completion evaluator interface. Resolve evaluator.toolManifest.path inside evidence commit E, verify its raw sha256/byteLength/mediaType, validate only against the independently pinned schemaRef/schemaSha256, then require parsed manifestDigest and signature to verify. The parsed manifest target C, mapping core M, portable contract, Case registry and evaluator tuple MUST byte-equal this record. Reconstruct its SourceTreeManifest, BuildAttestation and four role-exclusive runtime artifacts; produced and interpreted modes follow the manifest's exact output/runtime-identity rules, and any hermetic claim requires independent replay evidence. A Scenario RunnerManifest or an arbitrary transitive TOOL_MANIFEST cannot satisfy this evaluator-specific descriptor.
x-qmanStatusRule: The source Case definition and generated contract must currently be scope=PRODUCT and status=EXECUTABLE. IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED, HARDWARE_BLOCKED, FEATURE_DISABLED and REFERENCE_MODEL cannot be converted into completion merely by constructing this object.
x-qmanSignatureRule: Set completionDigest and signature to null, encode the complete object with CANONICAL-JSON-V1, store its SHA-256 in completionDigest, and sign ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/CASE-COMPLETION/V1) || 0x00 || the same bytes with TEST_EVIDENCE for E3 or QUALIFICATION_ENGINEERING for E4.
